description: Source code for BKP (Backup) peripheral functions for STM32F10x microcontrollers, including register configuration, tamper pin control, RTC output configuration, backup register read/write, and flag/interrupt management.

methods.name: BKP_DeInit
methods.description: Deinitializes the BKP peripheral registers to their default reset values.

methods.name: BKP_TamperPinLevelConfig
methods.description: Configures the Tamper Pin active level.

methods.name: BKP_TamperPinCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the Tamper Pin activation.

methods.name: BKP_ITConfig
methods.description: Enables or disables the Tamper Pin Interrupt.

methods.name: BKP_RTCOutputConfig
methods.description: Selects the RTC output source to output on the Tamper pin.

methods.name: BKP_WriteBackupRegister
methods.description: Writes user data to the specified Data Backup Register.

methods.name: BKP_ReadBackupRegister
methods.description: Reads data from the specified Data Backup Register.

methods.name: BKP_GetFlagStatus
methods.description: Checks whether the Tamper Pin Event flag is set.

methods.name: BKP_ClearFlag
methods.description: Clears Tamper Pin Event pending flag.

methods.name: BKP_GetITStatus
methods.description: Checks whether the Tamper Pin Interrupt has occurred.

methods.name: BKP_ClearITPendingBit
methods.description: Clears Tamper Pin Interrupt pending bit.
